entry_conditions: Drawer_position is above 0.26 m, red is visible and preferably acquired or within a demonstrated-style approach, and the current red_goal is valid and reachable.
exit_conditions: Red lies within pad containment and no longer follows TCP; after the retained overlap, blue is under TCP with closed fingers and observed blue/TCP initial-lift co-motion. These are switch cues only.
overlap_role: Complete [230,470) and [600,850) action supervision is preserved in all twelve demonstrations. The successor overlap includes final goal-relative red descent/release before retreat, blue approach, closure, and lift.
successor_readiness: The continuation beginning at 600 is deliberately ready for blue_insert despite red still being held or touching. Established blue lift near the end is the cleaner nominal switch.
failure_signatures: Goal-relative descent is unreachable; red misses, tips, or remains outside the pad; fingers open before support; red follows retreat; retreat collides; or blue is approached at a stale absolute location.
continuation_guidance: Refresh red_goal at each chunk. If red pickup itself is far displaced, prefer the red-object policy. If entry occurs after release or phase is uncertain, prefer the phase-conditioned local policy or successor skill.
limitations: No goal relocation occurs in the demonstrations, so translated-pad benefit is representational expectation rather than observed success. Successful runs do not prove contact recovery, collision avoidance, or IK feasibility outside support.
